templates.description: Writes a Monday brief of your key product metrics, with week-over-week changes and anomalies.

Runs each Monday at 08:00 UTC on the metrics that you list.
Compares last week with the week before and with the 4-week average.
Flags anomalies and looks for the segment or the event that explains them.
Returns a brief that a product lead reads in three minutes.

connectors.purpose: Query events, insights, funnels and retention.
Query the metrics that live in Mixpanel and not in PostHog.

templates.name: Changelog announcer
templates.description: Turns the Linear issues completed this week into a customer-facing changelog in Markdown.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs each Friday at 15:00 UTC, before the weekend.
Collects the Linear issues completed in the last 7 days.
Keeps only the changes that customers can see, and writes them in plain words.
Returns a Markdown changelog that is ready for review and publication.

connectors.purpose: List the issues completed this week, with labels, projects and descriptions.

templates.name: Experiment readout
templates.description: Writes the readout of an A/B test with the result, the confidence and a ship, iterate or stop call.
templates.what_it_does:
Takes a Statsig experiment identifier.
Reads the primary metric, the guardrail metrics and the sample size of each group.
Checks the sample ratio, the run time and the confidence before it makes a call.
Recommends ship, iterate or stop, and explains why in plain words.

connectors.purpose: Read the experiment, its groups, the metric results and the exposure counts.
Check secondary product events that are not in Statsig.

templates.name: Feature request router
templates.description: Takes a feature request in Slack, finds duplicates, and files or links a Linear issue.
templates.what_it_does:
Takes a feature request from anyone in a Slack thread.
Asks a maximum of two clarifying questions about the user and the problem.
Searches Linear for duplicates and adds the new evidence to the existing issue.
Files a new issue only when no match exists, and answers with the link.

connectors.purpose: Search issues, create an issue in the triage state and add comments.

templates.name: Feedback clusterer
templates.description: Clusters the feedback of the week into themes, saves each theme and proposes Linear issues.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads the Intercom conversations of the last 7 days each Monday at 07:00 UTC.
Clusters the product feedback into themes with counts and example quotes.
Saves each theme as a record that grows week after week.
Proposes Linear issues for new themes, and links themes that already have one.

connectors.purpose: Read conversations, tags and customer attributes of the last week.
Search issues to link existing themes. The agent does not create issues.

templates.name: Spec reviewer
templates.description: Reviews a product spec or PRD for gaps in problem, users, success metric, scope and risks.
templates.what_it_does:
Takes a PRD as a file (PDF, Word or Markdown) or a Notion page.
Checks five areas with a fixed checklist and rates each finding by severity.
Quotes the part of the spec that each finding is about.
Asks the questions that the author must answer before the review meeting.

connectors.purpose: Read the spec when it is a Notion page and not a file.

templates.name: Competitor watch
templates.description: Searches the web each week for competitor news and records each finding.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs each Monday at 08:00 UTC.
Searches the web for news about each competitor in its instructions.
Records each new finding with a source and an impact level.
Sends a weekly summary of the most important findings.

connectors.purpose: Search the web and read pages.

templates.name: Market sizing brief
templates.description: Estimates TAM, SAM and SOM for a market and a geography, with sources and assumptions.
templates.what_it_does:
Estimates TAM, SAM and SOM for a market in a geography.
Uses top-down and bottom-up methods and shows both.
Lists each source and each assumption next to the number it supports.
Searches with Exa, and with Tavily when it is connected.

connectors.purpose: Search for market reports, company data and statistics.
Run more web searches to check numbers.

templates.name: News digest
templates.description: Sends a weekday morning digest of 5 to 10 news items on your topics, each with why it matters.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs at 07:00 UTC from Monday to Friday.
Finds the news of the last 24 hours on the topics in AGENTS.md.
Selects 5 to 10 items and writes one line on why each matters.
Skips duplicates and press releases with no news.

connectors.purpose: Search for recent news on each topic.

templates.name: Paper summarizer
templates.description: Summarizes a research paper PDF into question, method, results, limits and relevance.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads a research paper PDF from a request or an email.
Returns the question, the method, the key results and the limits.
Rates the relevance to a topic that you give.
Finds related work with Exa when the connector is available.

connectors.purpose: Find related papers and later work that cites the paper.

templates.name: Source fact checker
templates.description: Checks each factual claim in a text or a file and gives a verdict with sources.
templates.what_it_does:
Splits a draft, an article or a file into separate factual claims.
Searches the web with Tavily for each claim.
Gives a verdict for each claim with the sources and a correction.
Skips opinions and predictions.

connectors.purpose: Search the web for sources that support or contradict each claim.

templates.name: User interview synthesizer
templates.description: Synthesizes several user interview recordings into themes with counts and quotes.
templates.what_it_does:
Transcribes several user interview recordings in one run.
Groups pains, needs and requests into themes with counts and quotes.
Separates what users do from what users say they want.
Saves one insight record for each theme.

templates.name: Call notes to CRM
templates.description: Turns a sales call recording or notes file into a HubSpot deal update and a logged note.
templates.what_it_does:
Transcribes a call recording, or reads a notes file, sent by HTTP or by email.
Extracts next steps, objections and decision makers.
Updates the matching HubSpot deal and logs a call note on it.
Returns the extracted data for your own systems.

connectors.purpose: Find the deal and the contacts, update deal fields and log a note.

templates.name: Contract handoff
templates.description: Extracts the key terms of a signed contract and writes a handoff for customer success.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads a signed contract PDF and extracts parties, term, dates and payment terms.
Flags special clauses that customer success must know.
Saves a contract record in the data store.
Links the result to the Salesforce account and writes a handoff summary.

connectors.purpose: Find the account and the closed opportunity, and add the handoff as a note.

templates.name: Deal risk review
templates.description: Reviews open late-stage deals each week and flags risks from call signals.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs each Monday at 12:00 UTC.
Lists open Salesforce opportunities at or after the proposal stage.
Reads the recent Gong calls of each deal for risk signals.
Gives each deal a risk level, a reason and a next action.

connectors.purpose: List open opportunities with stage, amount, close date and owner.
Read recent calls, trackers and talk patterns for each deal.

templates.name: Inbound reply drafter
templates.description: Qualifies an inbound sales email and answers it once in your reply style.
templates.what_it_does:
Answers each inbound sales email with one short, helpful reply.
Qualifies the sender with Apollo company data when it is connected.
Follows the reply rules in the reply-style skill.
Never gives prices. Offers a call instead.

connectors.purpose: Find the company size, industry and the title of the sender.

templates.name: Lead qualifier
templates.description: Scores a new lead against your ideal customer profile and records the result.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads the company and the contact of a new lead.
Finds the lead in HubSpot. Adds company data from Apollo when it is connected.
Gives a score from 0 to 100 with the reasons.
Saves the result in the lead data store.

connectors.purpose: Find the company and the contact, and read the deal history.
Add company size, industry and funding data.

templates.name: Meeting prep brief
templates.description: Writes a short brief for each external meeting on a seller's calendar every workday morning.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs at 06:30 UTC on each workday and reads the seller's calendar.
Matches external attendees to HubSpot contacts, companies and deals.
Writes one brief for each meeting: who attends, deal status, open points and goals.
Skips internal meetings.

connectors.purpose: Find contacts, companies, deals and recent activity for each attendee.

templates.name: Pipeline hygiene
templates.description: Finds stale deals, missing next steps and past close dates each Monday, grouped by owner.
templates.what_it_does:
Runs each Monday at 07:00 UTC on your Pipedrive pipeline.
Finds stale deals, missing next steps and close dates in the past.
Groups the problems by owner with one fix for each deal.
Checks Close leads too when the connector is present.

connectors.purpose: List open deals with owner, stage, close date, activities and last update.
List open opportunities in Close with the same checks.

templates.name: Proposal drafter
templates.description: Drafts a sales proposal PDF from a HubSpot deal and your scope notes.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads the deal, the company and the contacts from HubSpot.
Reuses sections from your Notion proposal library when it is connected.
Writes the proposal in Markdown and renders it as a PDF.
Returns the PDF file and a list of open questions.

connectors.purpose: Read the deal, the company, the contacts and the line items.
Read approved proposal sections, case studies and terms.

templates.name: Call recording QA
templates.description: Transcribes a support call recording and scores it against your quality rubric with quotes.
templates.what_it_does:
Transcribes a call recording that arrives by email or HTTP.
Scores greeting, empathy, resolution and compliance phrases from 0 to 5.
Quotes the transcript for each score.
Lists coaching points for the support agent.

templates.name: CSAT digest
templates.description: Sends a weekly CSAT score with the main reasons behind low ratings from Intercom.
templates.what_it_does:
Calculates last week's CSAT from Intercom ratings each Monday.
Groups low ratings by reason, with example remarks.
Compares the score with the week before.
Returns one short digest for the support lead.

connectors.purpose: Read conversation ratings, remarks and tags.

templates.name: Escalation summary
templates.description: Turns a long Intercom conversation into one clear Linear issue for engineering.
templates.what_it_does:
Writes the timeline, the customer impact and what support already tried.
States the exact ask for engineering.
Creates one Linear issue, or updates the issue that already exists.
Returns the summary and the issue link.

connectors.purpose: Read the conversation, the contact and the company.
Search, create and update the engineering issue.

templates.name: Knowledge gap finder
templates.description: Finds the questions support answers each week without a help article, and records them.
templates.what_it_does:
Finds repeated questions that support answered with no help article.
Groups the questions by topic each Tuesday.
Records each gap with its count and example conversations.
Updates a gap that already exists in place of a duplicate.

connectors.purpose: Read last week's conversations and search help center articles.

templates.name: Ticket helper
templates.description: Drafts answers to customer conversations in Intercom for a support agent to review.
templates.what_it_does:
Reads an Intercom conversation and the customer history.
Drafts an answer in the tone of your team.
Asks the support agent a question when facts are missing.
Never sends a message to the customer.

connectors.purpose: Read conversations, contacts and help center articles. Add internal notes.

templates.name: Ticket redactor
templates.description: Removes personal data from an Intercom conversation and its attachments before engineering sees them.
templates.what_it_does:
Removes names, emails, phone numbers and card numbers from support tickets.
Redacts each attachment with file.redact and writes a clean conversation file.
Returns the redacted files for engineering.
Lists the data categories it removed, never the values.

connectors.purpose: Read the conversation, its messages and its attachments.

templates.name: Voice support line
templates.description: Answers your support phone number, solves common questions and transfers callers to a person.
templates.what_it_does:
Answers support calls on a Run phone number, day and night.
Answers common questions from your support knowledge.
Finds the caller in Intercom when they give an email.
Transfers the call to your support team when the caller asks.

connectors.purpose: Find the caller contact and the open conversations by email.
